To determine the degree of accuracy attainable by this method
we must ascertain the strength of the current in $O A$ when this
condition is not fulfilled exactly.

be $\xi, \eta, \zeta$, and the resistances $\alpha, \beta$ and $\gamma$. Let an electromotive

the symbols $A, B, C$ and $O$. The equations of conduction are

a x=B-C+E, & a \xi=0-A, \\
b y=C-A, & \beta \eta=0-B, \\
c z=A-B, & \gamma \zeta=0-C ;
\end{array}$$

& \xi+y-z=0 \\
& \eta+z-x=0 \\
& \zeta+x-y=0
\end{aligned}$$
